decisions.reason: As a newly launched software product with at least one positive market signal and likely low incremental carrying cost, it remains a worthwhile option to keep open while demand becomes clearer.
Its visibility on the home page suggests active promotion, but with no clear proof of traction yet it is somewhat more exposed than the others, though still cheap enough to continue testing.

A configurable managed hosting offer is close to the firm’s likely existing capabilities, so the option value is high and the firm is likely to keep it on the market unless stronger negative evidence appears.
